 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u077/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2aa8c5d7.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recover the 4x4 patch hidden by the 3s using the grid's 180-degree symmetry."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("no masked cells (3) found")
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    # The opposite patch is mapped back by a 180-degree rotation.
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - (r0 + i)][len(grid[0]) - 1 - (c0 + j)]
             for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
